camel_example: aliyun ens ImportKeyPair --region cn-hangzhou --KeyPairName TestKeyPairName --PublicKeyBody 'ssh-rsa AAAAB****'
description_en: Imports the public key of an RSA key pair generated by other tools
description_zh: 调用ImportKeyPair导入由其他工具产生的RSA密钥对的公钥部分
kebab_example: aliyun ens import-key-pair --biz-key-pair-name TestKeyPairName --public-key-body 'ssh-rsa AAAAB****' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImportKeyPair

parameters.help_en:
The name of the key pair. The name must meet the following requirements:

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

Only one key pair name can be specified
parameters.help_zh:
密钥对名称。命名规则如下所示：

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。
必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、或者连字符（-）。

仅支持传单个密钥对
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en: The public key content of the key pair. Only one public key can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对的公钥内容。仅支持传单个内容
parameters.name: public_key_body

KeyPairFingerPrint.description_en: The fingerprint of the key pair. The fingerprint is generated by using the MD5 message digest algorithm based on the public key fingerprint format defined in RFC 4716
KeyPairFingerPrint.description_zh: 密钥对的指纹。根据RFC4716定义的公钥指纹格式，采用MD5信息摘要算法

KeyPairName.description_en: The name of the key pair
